title: Readiness of managers and health care workers for e-Health: a cross-sectional study in Khartoum primary health care centers, Sudan
why_not: An attitude survey of staff at Khartoum State PHC centres in 2022: it scores readiness and states no HMIS or EMR in use, no tier, entry level or clinic count; its one governance point (no e-Health in national policy) is already held.
